correctness.rationale: Every m>=0 sector is the q-dimensional weighted polynomial space with explicit positive Hilbert-type Gram forms. The subdisk change of variables gives an exact determinant and dilation singular-value reduction. Boundary-scaled orthogonal polynomials have factorial moments and Laguerre coefficient limits; a unique highest-order minor of each exterior power has a nonzero factorial Vandermonde determinant. Consecutive ratios give every sharp branch constant, after which eventually geometric decay proves the counting expansions and cancellation. The proof handles all m limits; 126 exact rational identities and 24 high-precision finite checks supplement but do not replace it.

value.rationale: The full order-q polyanalytic Bergman space and compact radial concentration are natural, nonarbitrary function-space objects. The result gives a structurally complete hierarchy for every q>=3, explicit factorial constants, an exact determinant, sharp log-log branch separation, and cancellation of q branch corrections in the total spectrum. Neither correctness nor reproducibility alone substitutes for this motivation.
